name: Closed and half-open Integer Range iteration

input.source_text: module M { public fun run() -> Integer { mut closed = 0; for value in 1 ..= 3 { closed = closed + 1 }; mut half = 0; for value in 1 ..< 3 { half = half + 1 }; closed * 10 + half } } M.run()
